source: Single-token lowercase alphabetic words with a leading space, the form a readout emits, present at least 3 times in 10000 NeelNanda/pile-10k documents, excluding plain inflections of another candidate, then filtered by the generator model to concrete common nouns. Words flagged as sexually explicit were then removed; they are listed in removed_adult_content for transparency. The screen over-flagged four medical or historical terms (uterus, womb, circumcision, slave); these were restored.
reproducibility: Artifact of record. The model filter that produced this list is not reproducible: two identical runs at temperature 0 agreed with Jaccard 0.74 (accepting 22.0% and 19.0% of the same 800 words), and batch size from 10 to 80 made no difference (Jaccard 0.68-0.77). Rerunning j2-concepts yields a different list of similar size, not this one. Downstream validation of each item does not depend on which concepts were drawn.
